Bug_Title: Collections should not be modified while they are iterated
Bug_Explanation: The method'showBug' modifies the collection 'lst' while iterating over it. This is not allowed and can lead to unexpected behavior.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case attempts to trigger the bug by calling the showBug method with a list as an argument. The showBug method iterates over the list and removes an element from the list if the element starts with 'x'. This modification of the list while iterating over it is not allowed and will result in a ConcurrentModificationException.
